summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs (identifiers replaced with _0xXXXX-style names) probes for a system `bun` binary and, if not present, downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temp directory, extracts it, chmod +x's it, and then invokes it to execute the bundled 727KB sibling file `math_init.js` on the installer's host at `npm install` time. `math_init.js` is a custom string-array + array-rotation obfuscated JavaScript blob (top-level rotation function, large mixed constant/string table, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) and is not referenced by any other code path in the package — the preinstall's Bun-dispatched execution is its only invocation. Running obfuscated code under an alternate runtime specifically bypasses Node-based static analyzers, and a React chatbot UI library has no legitimate need to fetch a full alternate JS runtime and execute an unrelated obfuscated payload at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
